title: Monoidal infinity Yoneda embedding and full faithfulness on operadic diagrams
statement:
Use the quasicategories, coherent functors, mapping spaces, universes and nonsymmetric monoidal infinity categories of [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'\in\mathcal U''$, and let $\mathcal C$ be a $\mathcal U'$-small monoidal infinity category; no colimits in $\mathcal C$ are assumed. Write $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U'}$ for $\mathcal U'$-small spaces and $\mathcal P(\mathcal C)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S_{\mathcal U'})$, formed in $\mathcal U''$. Equip this presheaf category with Day convolution: its tensor is the left Kan extension of $(F,G)\mapsto((c,d)\mapsto F(c)\times G(d))$ along $(\otimes_{\mathcal C})^{\mathrm{op}}$. Here left Kan extension means the functor whose maps into a target functor correspond naturally to maps from the original functor into its restriction. Then $\mathcal P(\mathcal C)$ is presentably monoidal relative to $\mathcal U'$. The Yoneda functor $j(c)=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(-,c)$ has a fully faithful strong monoidal enhancement
$$j^\otimes:\mathcal C^\otimes\longrightarrow\mathcal P(\mathcal C)^\otimes$$
over $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$, with coherent equivalences $j(c)\otimes j(d)\simeq j(c\otimes d)$ and $j(\mathbf1_{\mathcal C})\simeq\mathbf1_{\mathcal P(\mathcal C)}$. Fully faithful means equivalence on every mapping space, and strong monoidal means preserving all cocartesian edges. For every $\mathcal U'$-small simplicial set $K$ and fixed map $a:K\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$, postcomposition induces a fully faithful functor
$$\operatorname{Fun}_{/\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}}(K,\mathcal C^\otimes)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}_{/\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}}(K,\mathcal P(\mathcal C)^\otimes).$$
Here the source and target are coherent functors with the specified composite $a$ and transformations over its identity. For any specified collection $I$ of edges of $K$ whose images under $a$ are inert, the same assertion holds on the full subcategories of functors carrying every edge of $I$ to a cocartesian edge over its inert base arrow. All these comparisons are natural under precomposition in $K$.

source.place: Proposition 4.8.1.10 with K empty and K-prime all small shapes, in the associative-monoidal case, and Variant 4.8.1.11 (printed pp.710-711); the Day-convolution description of Remark 4.8.1.13 applies with associative rather than symmetric structure. Gepner-Haugseng 1312.3178v4, proof of Theorem 5.6.6 explicitly uses this monoidal Yoneda embedding and the induced fully faithful algebra inclusion. Full faithfulness on coherent diagrams is the fully faithful postcomposition property, using the full-subcategory model of functor categories; restriction to inert-preserving objects is full. Read online; archive WANTED. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical theorem.
